question: Describe the layout of the National War Memorial and explain the significance of its key structures.
options: The National War Memorial in New Delhi is built using concentric circular rings surrounding a central 15-meter obelisk a
explanation: The National War Memorial in New Delhi is built using concentric circular rings surrounding a central 15-meter obelisk and the eternal flame (Amar Jawan Jyoti). The innermost ring, the Veerta Chakra (Circle of Bravery), highlights key military engagements. The surrounding Tyag Chakra (Circle of Sacrifice) features granite walls lined with the names of fallen soldiers in golden lettering. The outermost ring, the Rakshak Chakra (Circle of Protection), is lined with trees representing soldiers guarding the country. Together, these structures honor the memory and service of Indian Armed Forces personnel.
